augmentationMatches.insightTitle: AI security, guardrails, evals and observability
augmentationMatches.rationale: Evidence-first tracing, evaluation, policy gates, anomaly monitoring and audit.
Route by quality, latency, cost, privacy, jurisdiction, availability and user entitlement.
Use bounded specialist agents with durable execution, scopes, approvals and result verification.
Adopt only authorized connectors/tools behind permission and audit boundaries.
Apply only to self-hosted/model-serving infrastructure after benchmarks; do not fake when using external APIs.

  return [
    'PANTAVION KERNEL FINAL AUDIT',
    `generatedAt=${audit.generatedAt}`,

    `foundationStatus=${audit.foundationReport.status}`,
    `readiness=${audit.foundationReport.readiness.status}`,
    `ops=${audit.foundationReport.ops.status}`,
    `controlPlaneMode=${audit.oneShot.entrypoint.artifact.controlPlaneMode}`,
    `resilience=${audit.oneShot.entrypoint.artifact.resilienceMode}`,
    '',
    'FINDINGS',
    ...audit.findings.flatMap((finding) => [
      `- [${finding.severity.toUpperCase()}] ${finding.title}`,
      `  key=${finding.key}`,
      `  summary=${finding.summary}`,
      ...finding.actions.map((action) => `  action=${action}`),
    ]),
  ].join('\n');
}
